title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall on 1970-01-10
lineage: Reel (Akai GX636) -> Apogee Mini-Me (24bit/96k) -> Apogee Mini-Dac -> Wavelab 5 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording captures an average early‑1970 show with a standout Me & My Uncle and solid Black Peter, but the overall performance feels pedestrian.
ai_review.review: The Miller 127228 soundboard source finally offers a clear picture of this first‑time‑at‑the‑venue set, fixing earlier balance and speed problems. Musically the concert is run‑of‑the‑mill for Jan ’70, with the highlight being a lively Me & My Uncle and an enjoyable Black Peter, while the rest drifts into typical early‑Dead territory.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is described as average with a few highlights; recording quality improved over older versions but still has minor issues, leading to an overall mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller's updated 127228 version fixes previous balance, image and speed problems; earlier sources were muddy or pitched slow. Some sections still sound a bit rickety.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First show at the venue felt rushed due to nervous staff, with no major jam sequences; overall an average early‑70 set that lacks landmark moments.
